Class Restaurant

java.lang.Object
commerces.Commerce
commerces.Restaurant
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Restaurant extends Commerce
Represents a restaurant, a type of Commerce.

Extends Commerce with restaurant-specific attributes: a weekly menu array, number of tables, and seating capacity.

The dailyMenus array has exactly 7 positions (one per day, starting at index 0 for Monday).

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez
